records.section: DomiGo v2 — Vision (the durable why) / How to run a session (the loops, in one breath)
records.requirementOrFinding: Boot: pull main → read this file + the BLUEPRINT status → verify docs vs `gh` → pick the topmost unblocked item → re-verify its spec against code → announce. Per PR: fresh branch, smallest-complete, full gate, Verification-honesty section, migration applied-to-dev-before-merge, leave the PR for Koki. Waves: worklist → template + calibration → **Koki register gate before volume** → agents draft → validators hard-fail → blind-solve on keys → fixed sampling → ≤1 unit/PR → stats in the PR body. Weekly: write the Vision-log verdict. Session end: passover (STATUS line, in-flight note, gate queue). Full text: BLUEPRINT Part IV.
